{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for nulls in flipper_length_mm
df_nulls = df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Number of null values in flipper_length_mm: {df_nulls}')

# Drop rows with null flipper_length_mm (since we need it for mean)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
print(f'Number of rows after dropping nulls: {len(df_clean)}')

# Check the distribution of species by island
df_cross = pd.crosstab(df_clean['species'], df_clean['island'])
print('\nSpecies by island (after dropping nulls):')
print(df_cross)

# Compute mean flipper length by species and island
mean_flipper_by_species_island = df_clean.groupby(['species', 'island'])['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by species and island:')
print(mean_flipper_by_species_island)

# Compute weighted mean flipper length per species across islands
# Use number of penguins of each species per island as weights
weighted_mean_flipper = {}
for species in df_clean['species'].unique():
    species_data = mean_flipper_by_species_island[species]
    # Get number of penguins of this species on each island
    species_island_counts = df_clean[df_clean['species'] == species]['island'].value_counts()
    # Align with species_data index
    weights = species_island_counts.reindex(species_data.index)
    # Compute weighted mean
    weighted_mean = (species_data * weights).sum() / weights.sum()
    weighted_mean_flipper[species] = weighted_mean

# Sort by weighted mean flipper length
weighted_mean_flipper = pd.Series(weighted_mean_flipper).sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the species with the highest weighted mean flipper length
highest_species = weighted_mean_flipper.index[0]

# Print the results
print('\nWeighted mean flipper length by species (across islands):')
print(weighted_mean_flipper)
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}')"}
